source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the bmc manager information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Verify that the intended BMC Manager information and detail view is readable and correct, and that every firmware version required for that manager matches the authoritative Project firmware matrix.
original_method: Identify the exact BMC and supported Manager member, capture the source WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs manager/detail view, collect the corresponding complete read-only Manager and linked firmware inventory data through protected access, normalize every required identity, health, state and firmware field, and compare each value to the approved Project matrix.
manual_activity: The Project owner supplies the Manager field list, firmware-component/version matrix and WebUI/API equivalence rule. Once those normal readiness inputs exist, protected collection, normalization, comparison and UI capture can be automated; the engineer reviews exceptions and owns the final verdict.
required_inputs: Trusted certificate and protected read-only credential path
Complete Manager detail and related firmware field matrix
Project-approved expected versions and normalization rules
safety_requirements: Keep the case read-only: do not call Manager.Reset, UpdateService, network, account, power or configuration actions.
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or SEL; preserve existing evidence and collect only relevant deltas when available.
Do not assume `/Managers/bmc`, use `curl -k` as formal validation or expose credentials in process listings; discover the collection/member and use trusted protected access.
Do not reduce all firmware correctness to one FirmwareVersion property; bind every required component and version to the Project matrix and linked inventory evidence.
Distinguish missing, unsupported, unknown and stale properties from a passing value; an empty or partial response is not PASS evidence.
Stop on ambiguous or duplicate Manager members, wrong-SUT identity, incomplete collection or irreconcilable version mapping rather than guessing or changing state.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the BMC target, Manager member/schema, trusted access, field/version matrices and redaction.
Collect the complete Managers collection, selected Manager resource and required linked firmware inventory read-only with timestamps.
Normalize manager identity/type, health/state, date/time, firmware components/versions and relevant links, preserving unknown or missing states.
Capture and correlate the exact WebUI manager/detail view or record an approved API override and uncovered UI coverage.
Return raw redacted and normalized comparison evidence without assigning DUT PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact Manager identity, required detail fields and component-level firmware/version matrix.
Approve the WebUI-to-API equivalence and any uncovered presentation/navigation coverage.
Review mismatches, unsupported fields and evidence completeness, then issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A read-only Manager GET is relevant, but the proposed command assumes a member, bypasses TLS verification, exposes credentials and emits only FirmwareVersion and Status. It cannot prove all BMC manager details or all required firmware versions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover the Managers collection and intended member over trusted protected access, preserve its complete redacted response and required linked FirmwareInventory members, normalize the full field/version matrix, then correlate the source WebUI view.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs BMC manager path, readable/correct and all-firmware Criteria, no Script/Bundle and 2/0-minute estimates remain preserved; feasibility depends on the approved field matrix.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform schema-driven complete read-only Manager and linked firmware collection, component-level Project comparison and WebUI parity capture.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected BMC Redfish Manager and its Inventory and LEDs manager/detail view.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, WebUI build, Redfish service/schema and firmware-inventory model.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor Manager/FirmwareInventory schema and Project-approved BMC firmware matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target discovery, trusted access, complete component evidence, objective comparison, timestamps and redaction while retaining the WebUI checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: API evidence is an approved override or supplement only; it does not prove WebUI navigation/presentation unless parity is captured, and one top-level FirmwareVersion does not prove every firmware component.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Manager schema/member, field matrix, component/version baseline and UI/API mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A valid response from the wrong Manager or a partial version property can create false assurance; manager identity and network metadata may be sensitive.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish or vendor inventory method may supplement or replace manual WebUI inspection only when the original method, actual method, reason, engineer approval, field-by-field equivalence and uncovered UI coverage are recorded. Missing Project SPEC data is readiness pending, not a permanent blocker.
expected_evidence: BMC/SUT/firmware/WebUI identity, trusted session, discovered Managers collection/member/schema and timestamps
Complete raw redacted Manager and required linked firmware-inventory responses
Normalized manager identity/type/health/state/time/link and per-component firmware/version matrix
Project comparison with explicit missing, stale, unknown, unsupported and mismatch outcomes
WebUI manager/detail capture or approved override coverage record, preserved logs and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure consistently target BMC Manager inventory, and the second Criterion narrows correctness to firmware versions. The generic phrase `System data` is imprecise but does not establish a competing ComputerSystem target when read in this row context.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only Manager purpose and target class are identifiable. Exact schema, member, Project versions and comparison rules are ordinary execution-readiness inputs; they do not justify a permanent BLOCKED classification.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains the relevant read-only API concept but rejects the hard-coded insecure two-field shortcut and no-risk claim.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees that the case can remain fully automatable once normal inputs are supplied, while independently preserving the source WebUI coverage and component-level firmware criterion.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces direct execution of the partial command with target/schema discovery, complete evidence and objective firmware comparison.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps host System, EROT security firmware and OAM chassis inventory as distinct identities and evidence sets.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No invalid draft exists for this exact source identity.

review_improvement: Turns a two-property response into a source-complete Manager and firmware validation contract, removes insecure access assumptions, preserves WebUI coverage and prevents one version value from being over-credited as all-firmware evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A BMC can expose multiple Manager members and separate active, backup, staged or component firmware records. Therefore a successful GET of a conventional `/Managers/bmc` URI and one `FirmwareVersion` string proves neither correct target selection nor the source requirement that all firmware versions are correct. The evidence must bind the selected Manager to the SUT, enumerate the approved component set and compare every value while keeping the operation strictly read-only.
